translations.idiomatic: On his return he reported: "Relocating the seat will uproot the people and still leave us maintaining dikes. Blocking the breach is the better course."

sentences.zh: 遂以冲知棣州，自秋至春，凡四決，冲皆塞之，就除殿中侍御史。

translations.literal: Thereupon Chong was made prefect of Di Prefecture. From autumn to spring there were four breaches in all; Chong blocked every one, and was promptly appointed Palace Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Chong was then appointed prefect of Di. From autumn through spring the river broke four times, and he sealed every breach; he was immediately made Palace Censor.

sentences.zh: 準為樞密使，卒徙州陽信。

translations.literal: Kou Zhun became Military Affairs Commissioner, and in the end the prefectural seat was moved to Yangxin.
translations.idiomatic: When Kou Zhun became Military Affairs Commissioner, the seat was ultimately moved to Yangxin after all.

sentences.zh: 而冲坐守護河堤過嚴，民輸送往來堤上者輒榜之，為使者論奏，徙知襄州。

translations.literal: But Chong was faulted for overly strict protection of the river dikes—whenever people transporting supplies crossed the dikes he had them flogged. An imperial emissary memorialized against him, and he was transferred to prefect of Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Chong, however, was blamed for guarding the dikes too harshly: anyone hauling supplies across them was flogged. An imperial envoy denounced him, and he was transferred to prefect of Xiang.

sentences.zh: 冲復上疏論徙州非便，著《河書》以獻。

translations.literal: Chong again submitted a memorial arguing that moving the prefectural seat was inadvisable, and wrote the Book on Rivers to present to the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Chong memorialized again that relocation was unwise and composed the Book on Rivers, which he presented to the throne.

sentences.zh: 會京西蝗，真宗遣中使督捕，至襄，怒冲不出迎，乃奏蝗唯襄為甚，而州將日置酒，無恤民意。

translations.literal: When locusts struck the Jingxi circuit, Emperor Zhenzong sent a palace eunuch to oversee the extermination campaign. Arriving at Xiang, he was angry that Chong did not come out to greet him and memorialized that only Xiang had the worst infestation, while the prefect daily held banquets and cared nothing for the people's plight.
translations.idiomatic: Locusts ravaged the Jingxi circuit, and Emperor Zhenzong dispatched a palace envoy to supervise the campaign. At Xiang the envoy, furious that Chong had not come out to receive him, reported that the plague was worst there while the prefect feasted daily and ignored the people's distress.

sentences.zh: 帝怒，命即州置獄。

translations.literal: The emperor was enraged and ordered a prison established immediately in the prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor's anger was aroused, and he ordered a prison set up on the spot in the prefecture.

sentences.zh: 冲得屬縣言歲稔狀，馳驛上之。

translations.literal: Chong obtained from subordinate counties reports of a bountiful harvest and sent them post-haste to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Chong secured from his subordinate counties reports of a good harvest and rushed them to court by express relay.

sentences.zh: 時使者猶未還，帝悟，為追使者笞之。

translations.literal: The emissary had not yet returned; the emperor realized his error and had the emissary pursued and flogged.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy had not yet returned when the emperor saw his mistake and had the man pursued and beaten.

sentences.zh: 以侍御史為京西轉運。

translations.literal: He was made transport commissioner of the Jingxi circuit with his censor title.
translations.idiomatic: He became Jingxi transport commissioner while retaining his censor's rank.

sentences.zh: 塞滑州決河，權知滑州。

translations.literal: He blocked the Yellow River breach at Hua Prefecture and served as acting prefect of Hua.
translations.idiomatic: He sealed the breach at Hua Prefecture and served as acting prefect there.

sentences.zh: 參知政事魯宗道總河事，用太常博士李渭策，欲盛夏興役。

translations.literal: Vice Director of the Secretariat Lu Zongdao was put in charge of river affairs and adopted the plan of Doctor of the Imperial Sacrifices Li Wei to launch labor in midsummer.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Director Lu Zongdao took overall charge of river works and, following Doctor Li Wei's proposal, planned to mobilize labor in the height of summer.

sentences.zh: 冲言徒費薪楗，困人力，雖塞必決。

translations.literal: Chong said it would waste wood and iron fittings, exhaust manpower, and even if blocked would surely break again.
translations.idiomatic: Chong argued that it would squander timber and iron, wear out the labor force, and break open again even if sealed.

sentences.zh: 遂罷知河陽。

translations.literal: He was thereupon dismissed and made prefect of Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: He was removed from the post and sent out as prefect of Heyang.

sentences.zh: 累遷刑部郎中，歷湖北、河東轉運使。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Director in the Ministry of Justice and served as transport commissioner on the Hubei and Hedong circuits.
translations.idiomatic: He rose again to Director in the Ministry of Justice and served as transport commissioner on the Hubei and Hedong circuits.

sentences.zh: 會南郊賞賜軍士，而汾州廣勇軍所得帛不逮他軍，一軍大噪，捽守佐堂下劫之，約與善帛乃免。

translations.literal: When rewards were distributed to troops after the southern suburban sacrifice, the Guangyong Army of Fen Prefecture received less silk than other armies. The whole army raised a great clamor, dragged the prefect's deputies into the hall and robbed them, releasing them only on a promise of better cloth.
translations.idiomatic: At the southern-suburb rewards for the troops, Fen Prefecture's Guangyong Army received poorer cloth than the rest. The entire unit erupted, dragged the prefect's deputies into the hall, and stripped them of goods, agreeing to release them only if better silk were granted.

sentences.zh: 城中戒備，遣兵圍廣勇營。

translations.literal: The city went on alert and troops were sent to surround the Guangyong camp.
translations.idiomatic: The city was placed under guard and soldiers were dispatched to encircle the Guangyong camp.

sentences.zh: 冲適至，命解圍弛備，置酒張樂，推首惡十六人斬之，遂定。

translations.literal: Chong happened to arrive, ordered the siege lifted and the alert relaxed, set out wine and music, had the sixteen ringleaders dragged forth and beheaded, and the disturbance was settled.
translations.idiomatic: Chong arrived just then. He ordered the encirclement withdrawn and the guard relaxed, laid out wine and music, had sixteen ringleaders dragged out and executed, and the uproar subsided.

sentences.zh: 初，守佐以亂軍所約者上聞，詔給善帛。

translations.literal: Initially the prefect's deputies reported to the throne what the mutinous troops had demanded, and an edict was issued to supply the good cloth.
translations.idiomatic: At first the prefect's deputies reported the mutineers' demands to court, and an edict was issued to provide the better cloth.

sentences.zh: 使者至潞，冲促之還，曰：「以亂而得所欲，是愈誘之亂也。」

translations.literal: When the emissary reached Lu Prefecture, Chong urged him to turn back, saying: "To gain what one wants through mutiny only encourages further mutiny."
translations.idiomatic: When the envoy reached Lu, Chong pressed him to return, saying: "Rewarding mutiny with what was demanded only invites more mutiny."

sentences.zh: 卒留不與。

translations.literal: In the end he kept the goods and did not release them.
translations.idiomatic: In the end he withheld the cloth and refused to deliver it.

sentences.zh: 入判登聞鼓院，以目疾改兵部郎中、直史館、知河中府，徙潞州，復為河東轉運使，遷太常少卿，擢右諫議大夫，復知潞州，遷翰林院學士。

translations.literal: He entered to serve as judge of the Petition Drum Court; because of eye disease he was transferred to Director in the Ministry of War, a scholar of the Historiography Institute, and prefect of Hezhong; moved to Lu Prefecture; again served as Hedong transport commissioner; promoted to Vice Director of the Imperial Sacrifices; elevated to Right Remonstrance Official; again made prefect of Lu; promoted to Academic Scholar of the Hanlin Academy.
translations.idiomatic: He entered to judge the Petition Drum Court, then, owing to eye trouble, was shifted to Director in the Ministry of War with a post in the Historiography Institute and appointment as prefect of Hezhong; he was moved to Lu, served again as Hedong transport commissioner, rose to Vice Director of the Imperial Sacrifices and Right Remonstrance Official, returned as prefect of Lu, and was promoted to Hanlin academician.

sentences.zh: 及徙同州，權西京留司御史臺，遷給事中。

translations.literal: When transferred to Tong Prefecture, he held concurrent authority over the Western Capital branch of the Censorate; promoted to Drafting Official.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Tong Prefecture, he was given concurrent charge of the Western Capital branch of the Censorate and promoted to Drafting Official.

sentences.zh: 喪明，卒。

translations.literal: He lost his sight and died.
translations.idiomatic: He went blind and died.

sentences.zh: 冲為吏，所至以強幹稱，能任鉤距，多得事情，然無家法，晚節尤寡廉聲。

translations.literal: As an official Chong was known wherever he went for forceful competence; skilled at investigation, he got to the bottom of many matters. Yet he kept no discipline in his household, and in his later years was especially lacking in reputation for integrity.
translations.idiomatic: In office Chong was famed wherever he served for hard-driving efficiency; adept at probing cases, he often uncovered the truth. Yet he maintained no order at home, and in his later years his reputation for probity was especially thin.

sentences.zh: 孫永，自有傳。

translations.literal: Sun Yong has his own biography.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Yong is treated in a separate biography.

sentences.zh: 崔嶧，字之才，京兆長安人。

translations.literal: Cui Yi, styled Zhicai, was a native of Chang'an in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Yi, courtesy name Zhicai, came from Chang'an in Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 進士及第，累官尚書職方員外郎、知遂州。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination and rose through the ranks to Vice Director of the Ministry of War's Staff Office and prefect of Suizhou.
translations.idiomatic: A jinshi graduate, he rose through successive posts to Vice Director in the Staff Office of the Ministry of War and prefect of Suizhou.

sentences.zh: 建議瞿塘峽置關如劍門，以察奸人。

translations.literal: He proposed establishing a checkpoint at Qutang Gorge modeled on Jianmen Pass to inspect for wrongdoers.
translations.idiomatic: He recommended a customs post at Qutang Gorge on the model of Jianmen Pass to screen out evildoers.

sentences.zh: 事既施行，徙提點刑獄。

translations.literal: Once the measure was implemented, he was transferred to judicial intendant.
translations.idiomatic: After the plan was carried out, he was moved to judicial intendant.

sentences.zh: 嘉陵江歲調民丁治堤堨，嶧更用州兵代其役。

translations.literal: Every year commoners were levied to maintain dikes on the Jialing River; Yi replaced their labor with garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: Each year civilian laborers were conscripted to repair Jialing River dikes; Yi substituted state troops for the corvée.

sentences.zh: 文州蕃卒數剽攻邊戶，守臣慮生事，多以牛酒和遣。

translations.literal: In Wen Prefecture, tribal soldiers repeatedly raided border households; local officials, fearing trouble, often placated them with cattle and wine.
translations.idiomatic: At Wen Prefecture, tribal troops repeatedly plundered frontier households, and local officials, afraid of provoking trouble, often bought them off with cattle and wine.

sentences.zh: 嶧請守臣歲時得行邊，益募勇壯，伺其發，一切捕擊之，後無復內寇。

translations.literal: Yi requested that prefectural officials be permitted regular border tours, that more brave men be recruited, and that whenever raids began the raiders be captured and struck down without exception. Afterward there were no further incursions within the borders.
translations.idiomatic: Yi asked that prefectural officials be allowed to tour the frontier each year, that more stalwart men be recruited, and that whenever raids broke out the raiders be hunted down and crushed. After that there were no further raids inside the border.

sentences.zh: 就除轉運使。

translations.literal: He was promptly appointed transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was immediately made transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 歷三司戶部判官、河東轉運使。

translations.literal: He served as adjudicator of the Revenue Section of the Three Departments and as Hedong transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He served as adjudicator of the Three Departments' Revenue Section and as Hedong transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 會更錢法，潞州民大擾，推其首惡誅之，人心遂定。

translations.literal: When the coinage law was changed, the people of Lu Prefecture were greatly disturbed; he identified the ringleaders and executed them, and public sentiment was settled.
translations.idiomatic: During a reform of the currency law the people of Lu Prefecture were thrown into turmoil; he seized the ringleaders and put them to death, and order returned.

sentences.zh: 後為戶部副使，以右諫議大夫為河東都轉運使，遷給事中，還，糾察在京刑獄。

translations.literal: Later he served as Vice Commissioner of the Revenue Section, was made overall Hedong transport commissioner as Right Remonstrance Official, promoted to Drafting Official, and on returning to the capital was assigned to inspect metropolitan prisons.
translations.idiomatic: He later became Vice Commissioner of the Revenue Section, then overall Hedong transport commissioner with the rank of Right Remonstrance Official, rose to Drafting Official, and on returning to the capital was charged with inspecting prisons in the capital district.

sentences.zh: 諫官、御史言宰相陳執中縱嬖妾殺婢，命按治。

translations.literal: Remonstrance officials and censors charged that Chief Councillor Chen Zhizhong had allowed his favorite concubine to kill a maid-servant, and he was ordered to investigate and punish.
translations.idiomatic: Remonstrance officials and censors accused Chief Councillor Chen Zhizhong of letting a favored concubine kill a maid, and Yi was ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 嶧以為執中自以婢不恪笞之死，非妾殺之，頗左右執中，即授龍圖閣待制、知慶州。

translations.literal: Yi maintained that Zhizhong himself had beaten the maid to death for disrespect—not that the concubine had killed her—and clearly favored Zhizhong. He was promptly appointed Gentleman Awaiting Orders in the Dragon Diagram Hall and prefect of Qing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Yi held that Zhizhong had personally beaten the maid to death for insolence, not that the concubine had murdered her, and plainly sided with Zhizhong. He was at once made Gentleman Awaiting Orders in the Dragon Diagram Hall and prefect of Qing.

sentences.zh: 羌井坑族亂，潛兵討平。

translations.literal: The Qiang Jingkeng tribe revolted; he sent troops covertly and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: When the Qiang of Jingkeng rose in revolt, he dispatched troops in secret and suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 歷知同州、鳳翔府，改工部侍郎、集賢院學士、知河中府。

translations.literal: He served in turn as prefect of Tong Prefecture and of Fengxiang; was transferred to Vice Minister of Works, Academic Scholar of the Jixian Hall, and prefect of Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: He served successively as prefect of Tong and of Fengxiang, then became Vice Minister of Works, academician of the Jixian Hall, and prefect of Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 嶧所至貪奸，比老益甚。

translations.literal: Wherever Yi went he was greedy and corrupt, and grew worse as he aged.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever Yi served he was grasping and corrupt, and only grew more so in old age.

sentences.zh: 在鳳翔，轉運使薛向按之急，不得已至河中。

translations.literal: While at Fengxiang, Transport Commissioner Xue Xiang pressed his investigation urgently; having no choice, he went to Hezhong.
translations.idiomatic: While serving at Fengxiang, Transport Commissioner Xue Xiang pressed his investigation hard, and Yi had no choice but to go to Hezhong.

sentences.zh: 請老，以刑部侍郎致仕，卒。

translations.literal: He requested retirement and was granted it with the rank of Vice Minister of Justice; he died.
translations.idiomatic: He asked to retire, was granted release as Vice Minister of Justice, and died.

sentences.zh: 田瑜，字資忠，河南壽安人。

translations.literal: Tian Yu, styled Zizhong, was a native of Shou'an in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Yu, courtesy name Zizhong, came from Shou'an in Henan.

sentences.zh: 舉進士，歷袁、郢、合三州軍事推官，遷大理寺丞，知鹿邑、建陽縣，徙知蒙、江二州，累遷尚書司封員外郎、提點廣南西路刑獄。

translations.literal: Having passed the jinshi, he served as military judicial assistant in Yuan, Ying, and He prefectures, was promoted to vice director of the Court of Judicial Review, served as magistrate of Luyi and Jianyang counties, was transferred to prefect of Meng and Jiang, and was repeatedly promoted to External Staff Commissioner in the Ministry of Rites and judicial commissioner for the Western Circuit of Guangnan.
translations.idiomatic: After passing the jinshi he served as military judicial assistant in Yuan, Ying, and He, rose to vice director of the Court of Judicial Review, governed Luyi and Jianyang, was transferred to Meng and Jiang, and was repeatedly promoted to External Staff Commissioner in the Ministry of Rites and judicial commissioner for the Western Circuit of Guangnan.

sentences.zh: 慶曆中，區希範誘溪洞環州蠻叛，上以瑜習知南方事，就除荊湖北路轉運使。

translations.literal: In the Qingli era, Qu Xifan incited the cave-dwelling tribes of Huan Prefecture to rebel; because Yu was versed in southern affairs, the emperor promptly appointed him transport commissioner for the Hubei Circuit of Jing.
translations.idiomatic: During Qingli, Qu Xifan stirred the cave tribes of Huan Prefecture to revolt; since Yu knew southern affairs well, the emperor at once made him transport commissioner for the Hubei Circuit of Jing.

sentences.zh: 瑜檄屬郡募民擊賊，又督轉粟以守要害，故兵所至皆不乏食，賊勢大挫。

translations.literal: Yu issued orders to subordinate prefectures to raise militia against the bandits and also superintended grain transport to hold key points, so wherever troops went they never lacked provisions and the rebels' strength was greatly broken.
translations.idiomatic: Yu ordered subordinate prefectures to raise militia against the rebels and superintended grain shipments to hold key points, so troops never lacked food wherever they went and the rebels' strength was greatly broken.

sentences.zh: 徙兩浙轉運按察使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to transport commissioner and inspector for the Two Zhe circuits.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to transport commissioner and inspector for the Two Zhe circuits.

sentences.zh: 杭州龍山堤歲決，水冒民居，輒賦芻塞之。

translations.literal: At Hangzhou the Longshan dike broke every year, and water flooded people's homes; each time the government levied fodder to block it.
translations.idiomatic: At Hangzhou the Longshan dike breached every year and water flooded homes; each time the government levied fodder to plug it.

sentences.zh: 瑜與民約，每芻十束，更輸石一尺。

translations.literal: Yu made a bargain with the people: for every ten bundles of fodder, they could instead deliver one chi of stone.
translations.idiomatic: Yu struck a bargain with the people: for every ten bundles of fodder they delivered, they could instead supply one chi of stone.

sentences.zh: 率五歲，得石百萬，為石堤，堤固而歲不調民。

translations.literal: Within about five years he collected a million [units of] stone, built a stone dike, the dike held firm, and in no year were the people levied again.
translations.idiomatic: In roughly five years he amassed a million [units of] stone, built a stone dike, the dike held firm, and the people were never levied again.

sentences.zh: 加直史館、益州路轉運使，改江淮制置發運使，擢天章閣待制、知廣州，累遷諫議大夫、權三司戶部副使。

translations.literal: He was given concurrent appointment in the Historiography Office and made transport commissioner for the Yizhou Circuit, changed to Commissioned Fiscal Transport Agent for the Jianghuai region, elevated to Gentleman Awaiting Orders in the Hall of Heavenly Manifestations and prefect of Guangzhou, and repeatedly promoted to Remonstrance Grandee and acting Vice Commissioner of the Revenue Section of the State Finance Commission.
translations.idiomatic: He was given concurrent appointment in the Historiography Office and made transport commissioner for the Yizhou Circuit, then Commissioned Fiscal Transport Agent for Jianghuai, elevated to Gentleman Awaiting Orders in the Hall of Heavenly Manifestations and prefect of Guangzhou, and repeatedly promoted to Remonstrance Grandee and acting Vice Commissioner of the Revenue Section of the State Finance Commission.

sentences.zh: 儂智高犯邕，瑜條上用兵禦賊十事。

translations.literal: When Nong Zhigao attacked Yong, Yu submitted ten points on employing troops to repel the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: When Nong Zhigao attacked Yong, Yu submitted ten points on using troops to repel the rebels.

sentences.zh: 智高平，召對便殿，具言南方山川險要，所以備守之策，乃以為廣南東路體量安撫使。

translations.literal: When Zhigao was suppressed, he was summoned to audience in the Privy Chamber, set forth in full the strategic terrain of the southern mountains and rivers and policies for defense, and was made Commissioner for Assessment and Pacification on the Eastern Circuit of Guangnan.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhigao was suppressed he was summoned to the Privy Chamber, laid out in full the strategic terrain of the southern mountains and rivers and plans for defense, and was made Commissioner for Assessment and Pacification on the Eastern Circuit of Guangnan.

sentences.zh: 還，糾察刑獄，同判吏部流內銓，除龍圖閣直學士、知青州。

translations.literal: On his return he inspected judicial matters, served concurrently as associate administrator of the Ministry of Personnel's Registry of Appointments, and was appointed Academician Direct in the Dragon Diagram Hall and prefect of Qing.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he inspected judicial matters, served concurrently as associate administrator of the Ministry of Personnel's Registry of Appointments, and was appointed Academician Direct in the Dragon Diagram Hall and prefect of Qing.

sentences.zh: 城中有殺人投屍井中者，吏以其無主名，不以聞。

translations.literal: In the city someone killed a man and threw the corpse down a well; the clerks, since there was no victim's name, did not report it.
translations.idiomatic: In the city someone killed a man and threw the body down a well; the clerks, finding no named victim, did not report it.

sentences.zh: 瑜廉得之，大出金帛購賊，後數日，鄰州民執賊以告。

translations.literal: Yu discovered it through investigation, put out large rewards of gold and silk to buy information on the murderer, and several days later men from a neighboring prefecture brought the killer and reported him.
translations.idiomatic: Yu uncovered it through investigation, posted large rewards in gold and silk for the killer, and several days later men from a neighboring prefecture seized the murderer and reported him.

sentences.zh: 屬歲凶多盜，瑜立賞罰、設方略捕格之，境中肅然。

translations.literal: In a year of famine there were many bandits; Yu set rewards and punishments and devised measures to hunt them down, and the district became orderly.
translations.idiomatic: In a famine year bandits were numerous; Yu set rewards and punishments and devised plans to hunt them down, and the district became orderly.

sentences.zh: 徙知澶州，背發疽卒。

translations.literal: Transferred to prefect of Danzhou, he died of a boil on his back.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to prefect of Danzhou, he died of a carbuncle on his back.

sentences.zh: 瑜謹厚少文，而於吏事頗盡心，然御下急，無廉稱。

translations.literal: Yu was cautious and solid, not given to literary display, yet in administrative matters he applied himself quite fully; however he was harsh toward subordinates and had no reputation for integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Yu was cautious and solid, not given to literary display, yet he applied himself fully to administrative work; however he was harsh toward subordinates and had no reputation for integrity.

sentences.zh: 施昌言

translations.literal: Shi Changyan
translations.idiomatic: Shi Changyan.

sentences.zh: 施昌言，字正臣，通州靜海人。

translations.literal: Shi Changyan, styled Zhengchen, was a native of Jinghai in Tong Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Changyan, courtesy name Zhengchen, came from Jinghai in Tong Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 舉進士高第，授將作監丞、通判滁州。

translations.literal: Passing the jinshi with high rank, he was appointed Vice Director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings and military second-in-command of Chu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Passing the jinshi with high rank, he was appointed Vice Director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings and military second-in-command of Chu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 後以太常博士召試館職，不中選，遷尚書屯田員外郎、知太平州。

translations.literal: Later summoned as a Taichang Doctor to compete for a post in the palace archives; he was not selected, and was transferred to External Staff Commissioner in the Ministry of Works' Fields Section and prefect of Taiping.
translations.idiomatic: Later summoned as a Taichang Doctor to compete for a palace archive post, he was not selected and was transferred to External Staff Commissioner in the Ministry of Works' Fields Section and prefect of Taiping.

sentences.zh: 上《政論》三十篇。

translations.literal: He submitted thirty essays in "On Government."
translations.idiomatic: He submitted thirty essays titled "On Government."

sentences.zh: 入為殿中侍御史、開封府判官。

translations.literal: He entered service as Palace Censor and judicial assistant in the Kaifeng prefectural office.
translations.idiomatic: He entered service as Palace Censor and judicial assistant in the Kaifeng prefectural office.

sentences.zh: 安撫淮南，還，以禮部員外郎兼侍御史知雜事，遷三司度支副使，除天章閣待制、河北都轉運使。

translations.literal: After pacifying Huainan and returning, he was made External Staff Commissioner in the Ministry of Rites with concurrent duties as chief supervising censor, promoted to Vice Commissioner of the Expenditures Section of the State Finance Commission, and appointed Gentleman Awaiting Orders in the Hall of Heavenly Manifestations and Chief Transport Commissioner for Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: After pacifying Huainan and returning, he was made External Staff Commissioner in the Ministry of Rites with concurrent duties as chief supervising censor, promoted to Vice Commissioner of the Expenditures Section of the State Finance Commission, and appointed Gentleman Awaiting Orders in the Hall of Heavenly Manifestations and Chief Transport Commissioner for Hebei.

sentences.zh: 言事者以為濱、棣等六州河可涉，宜有城守如邊，以待契丹。

translations.literal: Petitioners held that in the six prefectures of Bin, Di, and others the Yellow River could be waded and that fortifications like those on the frontier should be built to await the Khitan.
translations.idiomatic: Petitioners argued that in Bin, Di, and four other prefectures the Yellow River could be forded and that frontier-style fortifications should be built to await the Khitan.

sentences.zh: 詔昌言與宦官楊懷敏往視。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered Changyan and the eunuch Yang Huaimin to go inspect.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered Changyan and the eunuch Yang Huaimin to go inspect.

sentences.zh: 懷敏以為當城如邊，昌言曰：「六州地千里，又河數移徙，城之甚難而無利。

translations.literal: Huaimin thought they should build walls as on the frontier; Changyan said: "The six prefectures stretch a thousand li, and the river shifts its course repeatedly—building walls would be extremely difficult and without profit.
translations.idiomatic: Huaimin thought they should build walls as on the frontier; Changyan said, "The six prefectures stretch a thousand li, and the river shifts its course repeatedly—building walls would be extremely difficult and profitless.

sentences.zh: 契丹未渝盟先自困，非便也。」

translations.literal: Before the Khitan have broken the alliance we would first exhaust ourselves—it is no advantage."
translations.idiomatic: Before the Khitan have broken the alliance we would first exhaust ourselves—it is no advantage."

sentences.zh: 或請於麟、府立十二砦以拓境，又詔昌言與明鎬、張元度可否，昌言獨以為：「麟、府在河外，於國家無毫髮入，而至今饋守者，徒以畏蹙國之虛名。

translations.literal: Some proposed establishing twelve forts at Lin and Fu to expand the border; the emperor again ordered Changyan, Ming Hao, and Zhang Yuandu to assess feasibility; Changyan alone held: "Lin and Fu lie beyond the river and bring the state not a hair's breadth of profit; yet to this day we supply garrisons there solely for the empty name of 'pressing the enemy state.
translations.idiomatic: Some proposed establishing twelve forts at Lin and Fu to expand the border; the emperor again ordered Changyan, Ming Hao, and Zhang Yuandu to assess the plan; Changyan alone held, "Lin and Fu lie beyond the river and bring the state not a hair's breadth of profit, yet to this day we supply garrisons there solely for the empty name of pressing the enemy state.

sentences.zh: 今不當又事無利之砦，以重困財力。」

translations.literal: We should not now take up unprofitable forts and further strain our finances."
translations.idiomatic: We should not now take up unprofitable forts and further strain our finances."

sentences.zh: 就除知慶州。

translations.literal: He was promptly appointed prefect of Qing.
translations.idiomatic: He was promptly appointed prefect of Qing.

sentences.zh: 在州所為不法，語徹朝廷。

translations.literal: In the prefecture his conduct was unlawful, and word reached the court.
translations.idiomatic: In the prefecture his conduct was unlawful, and word reached the court.

sentences.zh: 昌言疑通判陳湜言之，追發湜罪，湜坐廢，昌言亦降知華州。

translations.literal: Changyan suspected Vice Prefect Chen Shi had reported him; he pursued and exposed Shi's crimes; Shi was dismissed from office, and Changyan was demoted to prefect of Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Changyan suspected Vice Prefect Chen Shi had reported him; he pursued and exposed Shi's crimes; Shi was dismissed from office, and Changyan was demoted to prefect of Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 歷知滄州、河陽，移河北都轉運使。

translations.literal: He served in turn as prefect of Cang and Heyang, then became Chief Transport Commissioner for Hebei.
translations.idiomatic: He served in turn as prefect of Cang and Heyang, then became Chief Transport Commissioner for Hebei.

sentences.zh: 議塞商胡埽決河，令復故道，與北京留守賈昌朝累論。

translations.literal: When it was proposed to block the breach at Shanghu Sao and restore the old channel, he argued repeatedly with Jia Changchao, Bejing intendant.
translations.idiomatic: When it was proposed to block the breach at Shanghu Sao and restore the old channel, he argued repeatedly with Jia Changchao, Bejing intendant.

sentences.zh: 徙江淮發運使，加龍圖閣直學士、知應天府，又知延州。

translations.literal: Transferred to transport commissioner for the Jianghuai region, he was given concurrent appointment as Academician Direct in the Dragon Diagram Hall and prefect of Yingtian, then prefect of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to transport commissioner for Jianghuai, he was given concurrent appointment as Academician Direct in the Dragon Diagram Hall and prefect of Yingtian, then prefect of Yan.

sentences.zh: 召還，會塞六塔河，以為都大修河制置使，辭，弗許，加樞密直學士、知澶州，以便役事。

translations.literal: Summoned back, when the Six Pagoda River was being blocked he was made Chief Commissioner for Major River Works; he declined but was not permitted; he was given concurrent appointment as Academician Direct at the Bureau of Military Affairs and prefect of Danzhou to facilitate the labor.
translations.idiomatic: Summoned back during work to block the Six Pagoda River, he was made Chief Commissioner for Major River Works; he declined but was not permitted, and was given concurrent appointment as Academician Direct at the Bureau of Military Affairs and prefect of Danzhou to facilitate the labor.

sentences.zh: 河決，奪一官知滑州，又知杭州，加龍圖閣學士，復知滑州。

translations.literal: When the river breached he was stripped of one rank and made prefect of Hua; he was also prefect of Hangzhou, given concurrent appointment as Academician in the Dragon Diagram Hall, and again prefect of Hua.
translations.idiomatic: When the river breached he was stripped of one rank and made prefect of Hua; he also served as prefect of Hangzhou, was given concurrent appointment as Academician in the Dragon Diagram Hall, and again served as prefect of Hua.

sentences.zh: 以老求罷，乃以知越州。

translations.literal: Citing old age he requested release from office and was made prefect of Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Citing old age he requested release from office and was made prefect of Yue.

sentences.zh: 至京師，卒。

translations.literal: Reaching the capital, he died.
translations.idiomatic: After reaching the capital, he died.

sentences.zh: 昌言為發運使時，召范仲淹後堂，出婢子為優，雜男子慢戲，無所不言。

translations.literal: When Changyan was transport commissioner he summoned Fan Zhongyan to his rear hall, brought out maidservants to perform as entertainers, mixed in boys for vulgar skits, and nothing was left unsaid.
translations.idiomatic: When Changyan was transport commissioner he summoned Fan Zhongyan to his rear hall, brought out maidservants to perform as entertainers, mixed in boys for vulgar skits, and nothing was left unsaid.

sentences.zh: 仲淹怪問之，則皆昌言子也，仲淹大不懌而去。

translations.literal: Zhongyan wondered and asked; they were all Changyan's sons; Zhongyan was greatly displeased and left.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongyan wondered and asked; they were all Changyan's sons; Zhongyan was greatly displeased and left.

sentences.zh: 其治家如此。

translations.literal: Such was his household governance.
translations.idiomatic: Such was his household governance.

sentences.zh: 論曰：狄棐、郎簡、孫祖德、張若谷、石揚休、祖士衡並以文辭高第，累侍從，歷方州，始為名臣，終鮮大過，考其行事可見也。

translations.literal: Commentary: Di Fei, Lang Jian, Sun Zude, Zhang Ruogu, Shi Yangxiu, and Zu Shiheng all passed the examinations with high literary rank, served repeatedly in the inner court, and held regional posts—they began as celebrated ministers and in the end were rarely guilty of great faults; examining their conduct shows this.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: Di Fei, Lang Jian, Sun Zude, Zhang Ruogu, Shi Yangxiu, and Zu Shiheng all passed the examinations with high literary rank, served repeatedly at court, and governed the regions—they rose as celebrated ministers and in the end were rarely guilty of great faults; their conduct shows it.

sentences.zh: 李垂寧去華近，不肯見宰相；

translations.literal: Li Chui would rather keep his distance from eminence than draw near to power, and refused to see the chief minister;
translations.idiomatic: Li Chui would rather stand apart from glory than court favor, and would not call on the chief minister;

sentences.zh: 張洞以直言正論為大臣所忌，則其抱負從可知矣。

translations.literal: Zhang Dong was resented by the chief ministers for his forthright speech and upright opinions—then his ambitions can be known from this.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Dong was resented by the chief ministers for his forthright speech and upright opinions—from this his convictions may be known.

sentences.zh: 若李仕衡而下十人，皆能任劇繁，然或寡廉稱，或有醜行，君子恥之。

translations.literal: As for the ten men from Li Shiheng downward, all could handle heavy and complex duties, yet some lacked reputations for integrity and some had shameful conduct—gentlemen were ashamed of them.
translations.idiomatic: As for the ten men from Li Shiheng downward, all could handle heavy and complex duties, yet some lacked reputations for integrity and some had shameful conduct—gentlemen were ashamed of them.
